rationale: The ten names Matthew lists from Perez through David (40.1.3-6: Perez, Hezron, Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, Jesse, David) match Ruth's closing genealogy (8.4.18-22) name for name and in the same order; this is directly checkable by reading the two lists side by side rather than inferred from either text's wording about the other. Matthew does not use a citation formula ("as it is written," or similar) to flag the dependence, which is why the label is "strong" rather than "explicit": the match is certain at the level of the two name-lists, but Matthew's own text does not announce it is drawing on Ruth.
